notes: The product channel of a six-person company building Slotwise, a booking and scheduling SaaS, over three working days of bugs, releases, customer asks and chatter.

messages.text: morning all
Initech says their bookings CSV export spins forever and then gives them a 504. They have about 400k rows this quarter.
the new export from the reports page or the legacy one under settings?
new one, reports page
Reproduced on staging with a copy of their data. Dies at exactly 60s, which is the load balancer timeout.
looks like we build the whole file in memory before sending a single byte
heads up: this morning's deploy stalled for about 4 minutes. the add_column migration on bookings took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and every query queued behind it
that's my reminder_sent_at column. I thought giving it a default made it cheap?
could we just bump the LB timeout to 300s for now? would get Initech unblocked today
ah, the default is now() so it rewrites the whole table. ok, I'll split it into add nullable, backfill in batches, then set the default
also, unrelated: who is taking on-call over the holiday weeks? the sheet is still empty after the 14th
I'd rather not touch the timeout, that LB fronts the public API too. streaming the response is the real fix
Umbrella Co flagged that invoice #2231 is a cent off from the sum of its line items. looks like we round each line and then add them up
classic. are we using half-even anywhere?
the PDF renderer rounds half-up and the API uses banker's rounding, so: both
e2e is red on main again, the reschedule-booking spec. passes fine locally
third time this week
same here on my branch
spike: switched to a server-side cursor and a chunked writer. 400k rows stream out in 38s and memory stays flat
btw the Globex utilization dashboard was showing yesterday's bookings this morning, anyone else notice?
the read replica fell about 9 minutes behind around 9:40, probably the same table rewrite from the deploy
lunch is here, the thai place again. there's extra if anyone wants to stream over from the other room
draft of the new welcome email sequence is in the shared doc. would love eyes on #2, the one about connecting your calendar
I can take the week of the 28th if someone else covers new year's
found it: the spec assumes the slot list comes back sorted, and after a reschedule it isn't guaranteed to
PR is up
+1, ship it
seeing duplicate events again for a few accounts that sync to Google Calendar. Initech is one of them
true dupes, or the old event left behind after a reschedule?
the second one. the old slot just stays there
Globex is asking again why the utilization report doesn't match their booking list
found it, not the migration after all: a long-running query from the BI connector has been holding up replay on the replica since 8am. killed it, lag is back to 0
re the deploy thing, Tom's split looks good to me, approved
pub quiz thursday, anyone? we need a team name that isn't 'Null Pointers' again
streaming export PR is up. it's big-ish, mostly the writer and its tests
morning
reviewing the writer now. what happens if the client disconnects halfway through?
the cursor gets closed in the finally, there's a test that drops the connection at 50%
missed that one, thanks
re the invoices thing from yesterday: Umbrella wants a corrected copy of #2231 before their month-end close. can we regenerate just that one?
yes, once the rounding fix lands. I'm making both paths use half-even and sum before rounding
also unrelated, the reschedule spec has been green 12 runs in a row since the merge
the leftover slot thing: on reschedule we send an insert with a fresh id instead of patching the existing one
so Google just treats it as a brand new event. fix should be small
left comments on Ines's drafts. #2 reads fine, #3 is way too long
and the split went out with the 11:00 deploy, zero lock waits this time
set a 2 minute statement_timeout on the BI role so that query can't pin the replica again, and added an alert when lag passes 60s
Globex asked on the renewal call whether we support SAML single sign-on. is that on the roadmap at all?
Google sign-in only today. SAML is a real chunk of work
approved the streaming PR, nice work
Fay re Globex, I'm fairly sure they're on Okta. I can ask their admin
put myself down for the 28th, Omar says he'll take the 4th. still nobody for the 21st to 27th
merged, it goes out with tomorrow's release
nvm on the calendar fix being small, we never stored the remote event id for accounts connected before March
rounding fix is up. regenerated #2231 on staging and the total matches the lines now
heading out early, dentist. back on slack later tonight
morning! the coffee machine on 3 finally got its fix deployed
cutting release 4.18 now: the streaming download, the rounding fix and the migration split
staging smoke is green
4.18 is on prod. asked Initech to try their quarterly download again
we could backfill the missing ids from Google's API by matching on start time and title, then the patch path works for everyone
matching on title feels fragile, people rename their bookings all the time
fallback is to leave the old ones alone and only fix new connections
Globex confirmed Okta. they'd want it by Q1 or they start looking elsewhere. not pushing, just relaying
Initech confirmed: the full-year file comes down in under a minute now
also: the welcome sequence went to marketing with Tom's cuts, they had no notes
I'll write up a rough estimate for SAML so Fay has something concrete to send them
and whoever ends up with the 21st to 27th, please just add your name, I'm not chasing again
fine, I'll take it
e2e red again, but a different spec this time, availability-search. timing out on the test db
have a good evening all, may your exports be fast and your invoices round correctly
